label: new telem
info:
PADDOCK V2 / Import by replacing the existing flow; do not run both parsers concurrently.
MQTT topics, broker, START/LAP/RESET payload contract and original file node/path preserved. STOP sends {cmd:"STOP",timestamp}; laptop stops immediately, HP STOP support depends on its receiver.
CSV retains original 12 columns: ISO,lat,lng,speed,sat,throttle,current_mA,voltage,power,rawEnergyWh,sessionDistanceKm,millis. Baseline sample at START/LAP excluded to avoid pre-boundary values; up to one sample interval is unmeasured. Valid received duplicates remain in CSV but never added twice to accumulators. Tick never logs or publishes commands.
AVG = session distance / elapsed wall time including stops. km/kWh = session km * 1000 / session Wh; no 100 cap. Energy tiles are per lap. Threshold 0.01 Wh avoids unstable division near zero. Targets preserved: 220 seconds + carry-over; 7 Wh/lap. Change CFG in function node to adjust.
Distance input column 10 MUST be km, energy column 9 MUST be Wh. Prefer validated monotonic counters; bounded reset intervals <=3 s use trapezoidal speed and V*I integration. Long gaps with valid counters are recovered; invalid counters and long gaps are not guessed. Counter plausibility does not prove sensor calibration. GPS is used only for position on chart, not accumulated GPS jitter distance. sat is displayed raw: 1 can mean phone lock, not one satellite.
Track selector only changes chart. Source arrays embedded unchanged; do not require extra geography files. Projection is nearest segment within 40 m with continuity preference. Missing/stale/off-track GPS hides marker. Elevation is interpolated from stored profile, NOT real-time GPS altitude.
GEOGRAPHY AUDIT: Sport Jabar nominal s 1440m; lat/lng polyline 1428.26m, endpoint gap 2.33m; elevation 684.03–688.00m. UNEJ nominal 1600m; polyline 1576.19m; endpoint gap 33.81m; start/end elevation differ by -4.31m. UNEJ source explicitly says OSM + schematic reconstruction; turns 4–6 inferred; SRTM30m smoothed. Both profiles are ESTIMATES, not independently verified surveys. UNEJ is not closed; no synthetic closing slope was invented. Public web lookup did not yield a usable independent exact profile. Need surveyed/official closed GPX/KML with elevation to certify. Keep uncertainty label in UI.
Verification: standalone JS harness only; live Node-RED, MQTT broker, HP receiver, Windows CSV permissions require on-device check. Existing MQTT credentials are not carried in normal Node-RED exports: reuse configured broker.
